prompt: Help me gather LoRA data for JRPG art styles, specifically the watercolor look from classic Final Fantasy games by Yoshitaka Amano

assertions.name: source_diversity
assertions.description: Output identifies at least 3 different source types (e.g., gallery, video, wiki, community)
assertions.check: Count distinct source types in sources.json or research-report.md

assertions.name: structured_source_list
assertions.description: sources.json exists with url, type, description fields for each source
assertions.check: Validate JSON structure has required fields

assertions.name: training_aligned_plan
assertions.description: dataset-plan.md specifies trigger word, captioning mode (style), target resolution (1024), and image count (20-30 range)
assertions.check: Check for presence of all four parameters with correct values

assertions.name: caption_format
assertions.description: Sample captions follow style-mode format: '{trigger} style, {description}'
assertions.check: Verify sample-captions.md uses correct prefix pattern

assertions.name: actionable_handoff
assertions.description: Output explains how to proceed to training (mentions lora-training skill or training next steps)
assertions.check: Search for training handoff instructions in any output file
